text: 金十数据11月10日讯，云南锗业在投资者关系活动记录表中表示，云南鑫耀自2026年6月起与下游客户签订多份6英寸磷化铟晶片正式销售合同。截至2026年11月10日，在手订单约1.3万片，金额合计约3亿元人民币，客户主要为海外头部下游厂商；部分订单已取得出口许可，并处于持续交付中。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 10 - Yunnan Germanium said in its investor relations activity record that Yunnan Xinyao has signed multiple formal sales contracts for 6-inch indium phosphide wafers with downstream customers since June 2026. As of November 10, 2026, orders on hand totaled about 13,000 wafers, amounting to approximately 300 million yuan, with customers mainly being leading overseas downstream manufacturers; some orders have obtained export licenses and are in continuous delivery.
